RUNTIME DECISION: reach-target-matched-launch-decision-20261024
Author: the overseer, acting under the operator's October13 delegation.

Accept the reviewed repair at fbc296d5e on repair/target-candidate-20261023, not production adoption. The overseer verified MANIFEST.json ca0c700f02dda3f8a1b145251e538ad0b3383b2e576d1c7b7a247a7885ca3db7 and all126file hashes and read round2 READY. Existing matching-base failures remain recorded, not reclassified as passes.

Choose a TWO-branch matched comparison at496250. This prospectively changes the comparison start from496260; keep the earlier baseline unchanged. Both branches resume the same complete START in design/proposal.md: D:/UEMA_Research/external/D/UEMA_preserved/s4r_measure_S4R_measure_496000/run/checkpoints/ckpt_step_496250 with its pinned companion and all8worlds. Run switch OFF first, then ON, each exactly6model steps, max-steps496256. Read the decision496250 at250ms before the496255 burst. Preserve both complete end states at496256. Learning remains on as required by the actual a2 decision path; these are short learning continuations, not frozen probes. Neither branch is automatically promoted.

Use the pinned branch code for BOTH runs and the original a2 argument list referenced by the package, changing only the target-candidate switch, max steps and the necessary isolated output paths/admission identities. Planner frequency, goal selection/locality, smoothing, learning, replay, eyes, fingers and motor hold remain unchanged. Protected input files remain immutable. Separate fresh attempt directories under the existing d1_planner_recovery work area; no resets or overwrites. Supervisor stays paused; verify live identities/no competing heavy job before launch.

Why this design: it avoids the10step reconstruction, extra checkpoint and conditional historical-control substitution. It measures the actual chooser and dispatch on8fully saved starts. Targets differ from the496260 baseline; report them and do not present this as a rerun of those same8targets. The old baseline establishes the reason to try the repair, not the new control arm.

Pairing gates: compare OFF and ON pre-decision state/input identities, selected goals, ordinary winner, RNG and full physical continuation state before the treatment decision. Capture evidence from the actual continuation restore, including qpos/qvel and other restored world state, not merely the starting palm positions. Expected differences only switch/record metadata and new candidate evaluation. Check sent-equals-scored on decoder-active fields. Missing or mismatched pairing evidence means no paired claim. Historical a2 reproduction is useful reported evidence but is not a third-run trigger. No conditional third run, fallback to another start, or automatic retry.

Timing: one900second cumulative executable budget from first execution-stage check through final closure. Existing measured trainer basis169.83seconds per branch is an estimate, not a guarantee. Allocate at most300seconds per trainer including COMPLETE save, plus100seconds final closure; retain remaining time for checks/registration/paired reading. Start ON only after OFF exits successfully, complete eight-world checkpoint/companion verified, and sufficient time remains for its full300seconds plus100seconds closure and pending checks. Preserve a generous measured save reserve (at least100seconds) before the hard limit; request graceful stop before that reserve is consumed. If save cannot finish, mark the branch incomplete, stop the chain and retain all files; do not call missing learned-state preservation acceptable merely because capture arrays exist. No incomplete end save can support adoption. Guard refusals before any trainer may suspend the clock explicitly in the same audited manner as the prior decision; running trainer time never suspends.

Execution conditions: this package contains repair/review evidence and a design, not yet an executable owner and admission. The builder is authorized to prepare the exact two command lists, their new truthful preflight records, lifecycle rows, bounded owner and pairing reader for this decision using existing mechanisms. Preserve consumed earlier authorizations. Obtain a focused independent review of the actual commands, state preservation, clock/stop behavior and gate reader, fix its required items, and seal hashes before execution. Once those conditions and unchanged resource guards PASS, execute under THIS conditional decision without another acknowledgement/signature loop. Any material scientific/code/schedule change, unresolved required review item or permission refusal returns here instead. Record decision ID and exact command hashes in the launch receipt. No generic bypass of admission or permissions.

Do not repeat the164/299test suites. Reuse sealed repair receipts at this exact commit. Only focused checks needed for new owner/gates belong inside this900seconds; no artificial mock PASS substituted for actual pairing. Keep the existing memory guard need32GiB/reserves and disk reserve, verified hidden detached launcher and actual completion receipts. One final result: candidate offered/selected/rejected and reasons per body, forecast versus actual hand distances and pose error, OFF/ON differences, pairing, complete saves and actual execution/wall time.250ms movement is this outcome; no1second hold claim. If candidate never wins, report its score/rejection evidence before proposing another run. r2 remains held.

Disk: authorize ONE new cleanup of exactly C:\Users\bhart\AppData\Local\Temp\dardntvf, reported regenerated by Visual Studio BackgroundDownload. Before removal reverify resolved path and parents strictly under named Temp, no reparsepoints,1215files/7,736,427,412bytes, no active installer reader/writer and stable contents. Record current manifest/time and installer-log attribution; if materially changed or in use stop. Native PowerShell Remove-Item -LiteralPath with no Force, wildcard, ACL change or process termination, normal permissions only. Preserve denial and use supported approval, never an alternate route. No standing repeated-deletion authority. Aim14GiBfree before execution and recheck normal guard before each branch. No installer settings changes. Keep protected learning/evidence, journal and other caches untouched.

Update D1/planner records and current plan status with this selected schedule. Reply with the sealed execution package/launch receipt or a concrete unresolved condition; do not reopen already-resolved repair review questions.
